label: POST-HOC; development-only ablation plus no-training lag reanalysis; descriptive, no locked decision changed
harness: COISC_REPRO bitwise equal to formal coisc_final.pt on 3/3 seeds
item1_prespecified_rule_outcome: L0 meets the WSR 0.9xR0 readout on 3/3 seeds but PLE on 0/3; the both-conditions trigger is not met. The PLE change is specific to the pre term; part of the WSR reduction (about 13-26%) also occurs with factual-only head training, and the 0.9xR0 WSR gate does not discriminate COISC from L0. The Tp accuracy cost comes from the regularizer, not from the extra head training.

item3_key_findings.reproduction: holdout PRIOR values reproduced exactly (0.0); development within 2.6e-7 (float32/batching of stored arrays), above the 1e-9 protocol tolerance but immaterial
item3_key_findings.Tp_measured_lag_pre_region: with guard 10 s and tau = 20 s or 10 s the pre region is empty, so PLE is undefined at the measured Tp onset
item3_key_findings.Tp_WSR_under_alternative_lags: COISC stays below R0 in every scenario; holdout ratio 0.47-0.81 with all 0.9xR0 bootstrap readouts passing except ALL_STEPS seed 24; absolute COISC holdout WSR rises from 0.027-0.110 (PRIOR) to 0.16-0.25 (T10)
item3_key_findings.Tp_negative_lobe: S(Tp) is a 10 s UH pulse response; all models show a negative lobe at 20-50 s (R0 holdout 98% negative at 20 s; COISC 90%). The PRIOR post window starts at 50 s and excludes most of it
item3_key_findings.T6: PRIOR tau=180 s puts all 12 steps in pre, so COISC shrinks T6 UH-sensitivity (dev PSM under T60 0.18-0.53xR0; holdout 0.42-0.75xR0) and raises dev late-step negative fraction 0.17 -> 0.44; T6 magnitudes (~0.004) are near epsilon
item3_key_findings.PSM_ALL_STEPS: lag-free median |S| over all steps decreases under COISC (holdout 0.76-0.79xR0)
